run_sdft_training: run small-scale SDFT training with Qwen model using privileged context or golden response datasets
build_privileged_context: build privileged context from golden responses using a configurable demonstration template
run_tooluse_evaluation: run tool-use evaluation on a dataset and compute action accuracy and JSON validity metrics
prepare_dataset_split: prepare a dataset split by extracting prompts and building privileged context columns
parse_action_input: parse model completions to extract tool action names and JSON action inputs
